messages:
marta: Manager here  submitted a mid-cycle 'step-up' for an IC who now owns platform reliability. It's ~11% increase. What route should we take and what attachments are mandatory?
kevin: Start with the comp-change intake (https://redwood-internal/forms/comp-change). Attach an evidence brief (3 bullets), updated org snapshot, and HRIS employee ID. evidence template = evidence-brief-v3 (Drive).
oscar: Approval routing: normal path = manager -> manager's manager -> People Ops. If this crosses a grade boundary add People Ops director to the chain. For financial review: annualized delta >= $10,000 -> Finance lead; >= $30,000 -> CFO.
ivy: Manager asked if peer notes are required. Short answer: optional. Focus on clear examples: scope increase, ownership, measurable outcomes.
marta: Retro pay question  manager wants backpay to the date the duties started (about 6 weeks ago). allowed?
kevin: Retro allowed but treated as exceptional. Finance prefers retro <= 45 days. Retro >45 days will need CFO signoff + written justification. Flag "retro" in the form subject.
oscar: Timing to hit next payroll: if form + approvals + cost center are submitted >= 6 business days before payroll close we have a good chance. If under that, mark PRIORITY and ping @people-ops-queue. Still not guaranteed.
marta: Equity refresh  manager wants to include a small grant with the comp packet to simplify things. allowed?
ioscar: Equity and cash comp are separate workflows. Do not mix in the comp-change intake. Submit equity via comp-ops. I'll loop comp-ops if you want help.
comp-ops-bot: Note: equity requests require a comp-ops packet, comp committee review window (usually 10 business days), and separate approvals. See https://redwood-internal/playbooks/comp-ops.
ivy: For international hires confirm local payroll code and confirm currency conversion with Global Payroll. Include local payroll ID to avoid errors.
marta: Any special handling if the person is on a temporary band exception?
kevin: Include the original exception memo and dates. People Ops will validate whether the exception should persist or be replaced with a permanent change; that may add a step to the approval chain.
marta: What about tagging in the intake so Finance knows it's urgent?
oscar: Put [PRIORITY] in the intake subject and add an explanatory line in the rationale. Also DM Finance lead and @people-ops-queue on Slack. We'll run a budget check; if it fails, Finance will open a ticket.
payroll-bot: Automated reminder: include GL cost code and HRIS employee id to avoid manual rework. Missing either will delay payroll.
marta: Thanks all. I'll resubmit with evidence-brief-v3, org snapshot, HRIS id, mark PRIORITY, and DM Finance.
ioscar: If you want, I'll review the packet before you submit to catch small errors.
ivy: Adding this thread to the comp-change playbook notes. Reply here if you hit a blocker. :thumbsup:
